assumptions.claim: Downstream logic must validate idle_d using a mubi4 checking primitive (e.g., mubi4_test_true_strict) before using it as a control signal; a single-bit fault in idle or idle_d could otherwise go undetected.
assumptions.cond: whenever idle_d is used to gate or enable any operation
assumptions.risk: Undetected corruption of the idle status may allow the HMAC to start processing while not truly idle, potentially corrupting cryptographic data or leaking internal state.

assumptions.cond: when any input changes asynchronously or non‑synchronously
assumptions.risk: Glitches on idle could cause spurious enable/disable of downstream circuits, leading to functional failure.
